title: 第9章 规则卡
novel_title: 穿越源卡大陆，我自带融合卡牌
content_zh:
突然的分手，并没有让林奇太过伤心。

    这里不是蓝星，找个对象都得排队。

    就像城里铁匠家的儿子，前几天刚突破一星卡徒，家里就已经给他说好了三个姑娘，连见面礼都备妥了。

    在这个大陆上，实力就是底气。

    别管是一夫多妻还是一妻多夫，只要你有足够强的实力，就算拥有后宫佳丽三千人，也没人会说半个不字。

    伸了个懒腰，将心底那点因分手泛起的别扭压了下去，林奇嘴里念叨着。

    “唉，命里有时终须有，命里无时莫强求。”

    要说遗憾也有，就像精心养了几年的女儿被黄毛抢走的感觉，的确不好受。

    但比起这点情绪，修炼路上的瓶颈才更让他烦躁。

    “老天爷爷啊，您看我桃花都断了，能不能在修炼上给我点幸运？”

    他的视线落回了桌上的卡牌。

    “让我看看，这分手费是个什么东西。”

    指尖捏起卡牌，阳光透过窗棂照在牌面上，露出一具灰白的骷髅架子。

    “一星召唤卡，骷髅小兵……”

    不得不说，这东西的确是林奇梦寐以求的。

    但他想要的是将自己本命卡变成骷髅小兵，而不是给自己一张骷髅小兵的召唤卡啊。

    “我这里还有一张二星御兽卡风铃猫，可一日突破不了一星卡徒，我就开辟不出卡槽空间，没有卡槽空间，这俩玩意都不如一张纸！”

    他攥紧拳头，一股不服输的劲从心底冒出来。

    “越是得不到，小爷我越要争口气！玫瑰伯爵能从废卡修炼成御卡宗师，我林奇凭什么不行？”

    唤出那张神秘的漩涡本命卡，林奇盘膝坐好，将刚恢复的源力一点点注入其中。

    这漩涡卡牌就像个无底洞，每次都能把他的源力榨得一干二净，连一丝一毫都不剩。

    可奇怪的是，每次源力被掏空后再重新修炼，他都能明显感觉到源力恢复速度快了几分，连体内源力的总量都在悄悄增加。

    正是这种“付出就有回报”的小金手指，才让林奇一直坚持着废寝忘食的修炼。

    ……

    接下来的几天时间，林奇过得真是平平无奇，除了修炼，还是修炼。

    林峰回来后就把杂货铺的活儿全包了，他每天就在房顶上修炼，从晨光熹微练到暮色四合，还美其名曰是吸收日月精华，修炼效率更高。

    这天午后，烈阳把瓦片晒得发烫。

    林奇盘腿坐在楼顶，额角的汗珠顺着脸颊往下淌，可他手里的本命卡始终没离手，指尖还在不断输送源力。

    “我这辈子就没见过像小奇这么刻苦努力的人。”

    瑞廉扛着两袋刚收来的草药走来，望着房顶上在烈阳高照下修炼的林奇，忍不住夸赞了两句。

    “行啦，你以为我儿子像你这种偷奸耍滑的家伙啊！”

    林峰接过草药，看向那几乎魔怔的儿子，心里既心疼，又欣慰。

    “哈哈哈哈，峰哥说的是。以前我们当雇佣兵时，每天修炼两个小时就坐不住了，小奇这孩子真是没的说……”

    瑞廉是林峰的老搭档，一位三星御卡师，现在处于无业状态，时不时过来帮林峰运输货物，在这小城镇内活的也算潇洒。

    “到饭点了，峰哥你不去做饭吗？”瑞廉看了看天色，太阳都快落山了。
content_en:
The sudden breakup did not make Lynch too sad.

    This is not Blue Star. You have to queue up to find a partner.

    Just like the son of a blacksmith in the city, he just broke through to become a one-star cardinal a few days ago, and his family has already arranged three girls for him, and even prepared a meeting gift.

    On this continent, strength is confidence.

    Regardless of polygamy or polyandry, as long as you are strong enough, no one will say no even if you have a harem of three thousand beauties.

    Lin Qi stretched out and suppressed the awkwardness in his heart caused by the breakup, and muttered.

    "Oh, there are times in life that must come, but there are no times in life, so don't force it."

    There are also regrets, just like the feeling that the daughter who has been carefully raised for several years is snatched away by a yellow hair. It is really uncomfortable.

    But compared to this emotion, the bottleneck on the road to cultivation made him more irritated.

    "Grandpa God, look at my peach blossoms, can you give me some luck in my cultivation?"

    His eyes fell back to the cards on the table.

    "Let me see what this breakup fee is."

    He picked up the card with his fingertips, and the sunlight shone through the window lattice on the card, revealing a gray-white skeleton.

    "One-star summoning card, skeleton soldier..."

    I have to say, this is indeed what Lynch has dreamed of.

    But what he wants is to turn his life card into a skeleton soldier, not to give himself a summoning card of a skeleton soldier.

    "I also have a two-star beast control card, Wind Chime Cat, but if I can't break through the one-star card disciple in one day, I won't be able to open up the card slot space. Without the card slot space, both of these things are worse than a piece of paper!"

    He clenched his fists, and an unwillingness to admit defeat emerged from the bottom of his heart.

    "The more I don't get it, the more I have to fight for it, sir! Earl Rose can train from a useless card to a master of royal cards, why can't I, Lin Qi?"

    Summoning the mysterious whirlpool card, Lin Qi sat cross-legged and injected the newly recovered power into it bit by bit.

    This whirlpool card is like a bottomless pit, draining all his energy every time without even a trace left.

    But the strange thing is that every time the source power is drained and he practices again, he can clearly feel that the source power is restored a little faster, and the total amount of source power in the body is quietly increasing.

    It is this little golden finger of "you will be rewarded for your efforts" that allows Lynch to persist in practicing without sleep or food.

    …

    In the next few days, Lin Qi's life was really ordinary. Apart from practicing, he still practiced.

    After Lin Feng came back, he took over all the work in the grocery store. He practiced on the roof every day, from dawn to dusk. He even said that he absorbed the essence of the sun and the moon, making his cultivation more efficient.

    In the afternoon of this day, the scorching sun made the tiles very hot.

    Lin Qi sat cross-legged on the roof of the building, sweat beads on his forehead flowing down his cheeks, but the life card in his hand never left his hand, and his fingertips continued to transmit power.

    "I have never seen anyone as hard-working as Xiaoqi in my life."

    Ruilian came over carrying two bags of freshly collected herbs. He looked at Lin Qi practicing under the blazing sun on the roof and couldn't help but praise him.

    "Okay, you think my son is a sneaky guy like you!"

    Lin Feng took the herbal medicine and looked at his almost dazed son, feeling both distressed and relieved.

    "Hahahaha, that's what Brother Feng said. When we were mercenaries, we couldn't sit still after practicing for two hours a day. This kid Xiaoqi really has nothing to say..."

    Ruilian is Lin Feng's old partner, a three-star card master. He is currently unemployed. He comes over from time to time to help Lin Feng transport goods. He lives a comfortable life in this small town.

    "It's dinner time, Brother Feng, aren't you going to cook?" Ruilian looked at the sky and saw that the sun was almost setting.
